pr.title: fix(dispatcher): preserve Codex carrier policy and launch diagnostics
pr.body:
Local Codex process launches previously received a forced permission override and lost precise pre-event launch errors. This change preserves host-selected permissions, retains actionable diagnostics, records stdin/initialization progress, and keeps Sprite's existing carrier behavior.

The owner has selected the physically verified macOS arm64 carrier for #78: Codex CLI 0.153.4, existing ChatGPT login, gpt-5.6-sol. On this exact head, the actual Noodle ProcessDispatcher launched an Agent that executed the event tool and produced one matching session/order/stage outcome in 21.30 seconds. [Receipt and raw traces](https://github.com/ed3c/noodle/tree/2e166473c4939f88fc55db3b78d96b85459ff728/evidence/78/macos-process-dispatch).

Validation: canonical pnpm check passed on exact head e6d712a2512547cdf78a85c1ee218e1ba52e3b27 with clean source (61.03 seconds); [Test](https://github.com/ed3c/noodle/actions/runs/35080572639) and [Actions worktree runtime](https://github.com/ed3c/noodle/actions/runs/35080572554) passed. [Historical startup controls](https://github.com/ed3c/noodle/blob/9b79c142c95916a1983834e9ce7c656f68e66a54/evidence/78/stdin-initialization.json) include planted-defect failures and restored race-suite success. The macOS invalid-config refusal is GREEN, not a new defect RED.

The old /opt/codex/bin/codex carrier timeout remains unresolved historical evidence; this PR does not claim its root cause was fixed. Actions proves runtime behavior, not nested Agent execution. No credential/policy changes, production scheduling or Soodles #18 implementation are claimed. Delivery and reconciliation remain separate requirements.

Refs ed3c/noodle#78

@@ -0,0 +1,108 @@
+name: Noodle Actions runtime
+
+on:
+  pull_request:
+    paths:
+      - .github/workflows/codex-actions-capability.yml
+      - dispatcher/**
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+jobs:
+  worktree-runtime:
+    if: github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 10
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
+        with:
+          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
+          persist-credentials: false
+      - uses: actions/setup-go@d35c59abb061a4a6fb18e82ac0862c26744d6ab5
+        with:
+          go-version-file: go.mod
+      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
+      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
+        with:
+          node-version: 22
+          cache: pnpm
+      - name: Build the candidate through the repository entrypoint
+        run: |
+          pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
+          pnpm build
+
+      # Fixed external control; no API-key admission rule or model request.
+      # This non-authorizing runtime probe is not the landing verifier.
+      - name: Exercise Noodle worktree ownership without model credentials
+        env:
+          CANDIDATE_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
+          WORKFLOW_SHA: ${{ github.workflow_sha }}
+          TARGET_REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
+        run: |
+          python3 -B - <<'PYTHON'
+          import hashlib
+          import json
+          import os
+          from pathlib import Path
+          import runpy
+          import subprocess
+          import urllib.request
+
+          oracle_commit = "0256f2923e978b989e25df07c74db4370d343312"
+          oracle_digest = "d65b8ba15f2cdbfdd43c4fc0bf267c78ccb2b38208171623b1291704b144c6d9"
+          receipt = {
+              "schema_version": 2,
+              "carrier": "github-actions",
+              "repository": os.environ["TARGET_REPOSITORY"],
+              "candidate_head": os.environ["CANDIDATE_HEAD"],
+              "workflow_sha": os.environ["WORKFLOW_SHA"],
+              "run_id": os.environ["GITHUB_RUN_ID"],
+              "run_attempt": os.environ["GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT"],
+              "scope": "Noodle worktree create/exec/refusal/cleanup",
+              "runtime": "FAILED",
+              "nested_agent": "NOT_EVALUATED",
+              "typed_outcome_observed": False,
+              "authorizes_landing": False,
+              "local_carrier_verdict": "NOT_EVALUATED",
+              "oracle": {"repository": "ed3c/soodles", "commit": oracle_commit,
+                         "path": "soodles.py", "sha256": oracle_digest},
+          }
+          try:
+              head = subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip()
+              if head != receipt["candidate_head"]:
+                  raise RuntimeError(f"candidate_head mismatch: {head}")
+              receipt["candidate_tree"] = subprocess.check_output(
+                  ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD^{tree}"], text=True).strip()
+              url = f"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ed3c/soodles/{oracle_commit}/soodles.py"
+              with urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=30) as response:
+                  source = response.read()
+              if hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest() != oracle_digest:
+                  raise RuntimeError("fixed external oracle SHA-256 mismatch")
+              oracle_path = Path(os.environ["RUNNER_TEMP"]) / "fixed-soodles-oracle.py"
+              oracle_path.write_bytes(source)
+              oracle = runpy.run_path(str(oracle_path))
+              binary = Path("bin/noodle").resolve()
+              receipt["binary_sha256"] = oracle["digest"](binary)
+              receipt["binary_version"] = oracle["checked"]([binary, "--version"], Path.cwd())
+              receipt["physical"] = oracle["worktree_probe"](binary)
+              if oracle["digest"](binary) != receipt["binary_sha256"]:
+                  raise RuntimeError("candidate binary changed during probe")
+              receipt["runtime"] = "PASS"
+          except Exception as error:
+              receipt["error"] = f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}"
+              raise
+          finally:
+              path = Path(os.environ["RUNNER_TEMP"]) / "noodle-actions-runtime.json"
+              path.write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + "\n")
+              print(json.dumps(receipt))
+          PYTHON
+
+      - name: Preserve runtime receipt
+        if: always()
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
+        with:
+          name: noodle-actions-runtime-${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
+          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/noodle-actions-runtime.json
+          if-no-files-found: error
+          retention-days: 30

@@ -0,0 +1,63 @@
+# Codex launch carrier contract
+
+Observed for ed3c/noodle#78 on 2026-09-16. The process dispatcher inherited an
+unconditional `--dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox` from `codexBaseArgs`.
+The managed carrier rejected its approval/sandbox combination before Agent
+events. Non-interactive `exec` does not require that override.
+
+- Shared Codex argv owns the execution protocol. Process dispatch preserves host
+  configuration and existing `agents.codex.args`; Codex validates those values.
+- Sprite keeps its existing explicit override at its own argument producer.
+  This preserves that carrier's behavior; it is not a new Sprite runtime proof.
+- A pre-event Codex failure retains the first raw `Error:` diagnostic in the
+  session outcome after stderr persistence, with `codex exec --help` as the
+  supported next entry. Unknown failures, cancellation, other providers and
+  failures after initialization keep their existing classification.
+- Neither this diagnostic nor a CLI exit code authorizes an unchanged retry.
+  Bootstrap retry/exhaustion belongs to the loop owner and is outside this fix.
+
+The nearest controls are `dispatcher/codex_launch_test.go`. They distinguish
+permission injection, lost diagnostics and changes to the Sprite caller. They
+are not authenticated Agent execution receipts.
+
+A real process-dispatch probe with an invalid sandbox value failed before Agent
+events and preserved the CLI's exact field/value. The permitted-config probe
+timed out after 90 seconds with no Agent events; both disposable Noodle
+worktrees were cleaned through `noodle worktree cleanup`. Installed CLI
+0.154.0-alpha.3 and a separate 0.153.3 direct probe have not produced a successful
+Agent execution in this carrier. No model authentication failure has been
+established from these timeouts. Do not infer that removing the flag completes
+#78 or unblocks Soodles #18.
+
+ChatGPT GitHub connector transport plus ordinary Actions runtime tests is a
+different path from starting another Codex process inside a runner. Each actual
+Agent carrier requires its own successful launch and typed-outcome receipt.
+
+The process owner writes `sessions/<id>/codex-startup.json` to distinguish
+stdin write start, completed byte count/error, and close completion/error.
+First stdout/stderr read and first canonical `init` are separate observations;
+raw stderr is not initialization. Null timestamps/counts mean not observed.
+Successful write/close proves only the parent's pipe operations returned, not
+that Codex consumed the prompt or completed work. The receipt contains no prompt
+content, is not replayed, and cannot authorize retry or change session outcome.
+Persistence errors are logged and retained on a later successful receipt write.
+
+`dispatcher/codex_startup_test.go` exercises the actual child-process stdin/EOF
+and output consumers, blocked-input cancellation, independent write/close
+failures, pending operations and initialization discrimination. Planted lost
+byte counts, close diagnostics and initialization consumption are rejected.
+These controls observe the process boundary; they do not expose Codex's internal
+MCP/network initialization steps or establish authenticated Agent execution.
+
+An Actions preflight incorrectly required `secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY` before any
+Noodle runtime execution. Its missing-input result was not a runtime failure.
+API keys are not required for the supervised connector plus Actions path, and
+must not become an admission rule for Noodle worktree operations. The corrected
+workflow builds the exact candidate and reuses the fixed external Soodles
+worktree control at `0256f2923e978b989e25df07c74db4370d343312`, checking its bytes
+before execution. That control strips inherited credentials from subprocesses
+and verifies real create/exec, absent-target refusal before side effects, and
+cleanup with Git readback. It emits separate runtime and nested-Agent verdicts.
+This is non-authorizing runtime evidence, not the full Soodles acceptance or an
+isolated landing judge. A successful worktree probe cannot establish successful
+Codex inference, scheduling, or resolution of the managed carrier timeout.

issue.title: Local Codex CLI process dispatch: preserve carrier policy and prove Agent completion
issue.body:
## Current contract — selected local carrier, 2026-09-16

The repository owner explicitly instructed: proceed using the physically verified macOS/Codex CLI identity, correct the old environment restriction, preserve the former /opt carrier failure as unresolved historical evidence, and complete #79 delivery and Soodles #18 integration separately. This is the current contract. [Prior Issue body](https://github.com/ed3c/noodle/blob/70bc6b858600c2331b7e9f135e0886579c74d2a5/evidence/78/carrier-selection/issue-before.md) and [prior PR body](https://github.com/ed3c/noodle/blob/70bc6b858600c2331b7e9f135e0886579c74d2a5/evidence/78/carrier-selection/pr-before.md) are immutable historical evidence, not current routing or permission.

### Causal correction and immutable candidate

Owner: Noodle's existing Codex ProcessDispatcher launch boundary. PR #79, branch issue-78-codex-launch, head e6d712a2512547cdf78a85c1ee218e1ba52e3b27, tree 87c23adcc96b1bf10a1fd8983409cd80e3713310, delivered base 1ba241abb68333b5c53d9d23955f538b2cb63877.

The shared argv formerly injected --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox into local process launches. The candidate preserves host policy, keeps Sprite's prior carrier contract, retains actionable pre-event diagnostics, and records session-bound stdin/initialization observations. No second scheduler, permission selector, credential change or retry engine is admitted.

The existing nine-file implementation boundary remains: dispatcher/command.go, dispatcher/process_dispatcher.go, dispatcher/process_session.go, dispatcher/sprites_dispatcher.go, dispatcher/codex_launch_test.go, dispatcher/codex_startup.go, dispatcher/codex_startup_test.go, brain/codebase/codex-launch-carrier-contract.md, .github/workflows/codex-actions-capability.yml. No further source edits are selected by this carrier amendment.

### Selected execution identity and successful capability

The selected carrier is macOS arm64, Codex CLI 0.153.4 at /Users/neon/.local/bin/codex (resolved standalone aarch64-apple-darwin binary), existing ChatGPT login, gpt-5.6-sol. Codex binary SHA-256 b973d440acac501fd2594a43e7ca9ce41e0a65b9dfb28d0d7a7837c99e1261e3. Candidate-native Noodle SHA-256 d7a8a8de88d37a396e9441b7dc0ab4ea140415674354a96ac7716d9753b9ffd3. The probe requested workspace-write, approval_policy=never and only the disposable fixture as an additional writable directory; no persistent host policy or credentials were changed.

[Original receipt and full traces](https://github.com/ed3c/noodle/tree/2e166473c4939f88fc55db3b78d96b85459ff728/evidence/78/macos-process-dispatch) were published and all 39 files read back byte-for-byte. Receipt SHA-256 24a67f60c1c440b4ce026741ed3bb7ca9829532a1d4482aa965e036199a522d3.

Actual ProcessDispatcher session launch-probe-20260916-142217-4fc5f5 launched Codex thread 01a0aa98-d71b-7af0-9412-88cb7c9c7eab. The Agent executed the requested Noodle event tool and emitted exactly one completed, nonblocking stage_message bound to that session, order launch-capability-78 and stage 0. Observer readback matched; elapsed 21.300518833 seconds within 90 seconds, process outcome completed/exit 0. The observer did not emit that event. Noodle removed the disposable worktree and branch; source remained clean. Raw process-absence snapshot limitations are stated in the packet.

Illegal sandbox input produced a GREEN rejection control before Agent events, preserving invalid-mode and codex exec --help. The legal real execution is GREEN. This macOS experiment did not run a new defect RED arm; do not relabel rejection as RED. The prior [startup discriminator controls](https://github.com/ed3c/noodle/blob/9b79c142c95916a1983834e9ce7c656f68e66a54/evidence/78/stdin-initialization.json) remain historical controls and must be inspected within their own subject.

### Historical carrier remains unresolved

The prior managed carrier used /opt/codex/bin/codex 0.154.0-alpha.3. It wrote/closed stdin and reached internal initialization, but emitted no matching Agent outcome before 90-second cancellation. [Unresolved original receipt](https://github.com/ed3c/noodle/blob/aa5de0cab604f58ae11905fed5ae65740e667c4e/evidence/78/child-initialization.json). Its startup root cause is not fixed or inferred by macOS success. Work Mode is a UI/mode label, not a substitute for exact host/binary/candidate identity. The former carrier is no longer a required success condition for this selected local deployment; its failure must not blanket-block Soodles #18.

GitHub Actions remains the build/test/worktree-runtime carrier. No nested Codex Agent on Actions is required or claimed. No API-key-only prerequisite.

### Verification and delivery still required

Exact-head local canonical pnpm check passed in 61.028987666999456 seconds with clean source on the selected macOS carrier. Existing exact-head Test run 35080572639 and Actions runtime run 35080572554 succeeded. Those results and scoped capability do not authorize themselves or mean RESOLVED.

Proceed through the existing owner-authorized supervised GitHub transport route demonstrated by #80, preserving expected candidate head, ordinary provider checks, merge/closure readbacks and actual Noodle reconciliation. Do not route this supervised PR through the separate noodles-dispatch contract or forge its authorization markers. Do not alter provider protections or let candidate code select an external judge. Unknown provider writes require fresh readback, never a replay.

Before provider landing, inspect the existing defect/cure/legal controls and actual changed files. Preserve the existing fixed verification boundary; no candidate-head acceptance rerun is needed without a changed subject, failure or unresolved concern. PR #79 remains unmerged until provider readback proves otherwise. Issue #78 remains open until delivery and required reconciliation are evidenced; unavailable historical worktree cleanup must be disclosed, not invented.

Soodles #18 owns its distinct shared validator, real automatic/supervised consumers, execution envelope and delivery. This receipt neither changes its runtime.lock.json nor implements its admission owner. Freeze that exact implementation boundary against the selected deployment carrier, then implement the causal atom with defect RED / cure GREEN / legal non-case GREEN controls.
